PINNACLE AT A GLANCE

Measurement. A connected plan.
Support for everyday life.

Section link

Pinnacle Blooms Network is a brand of Bharath Healthcare Laboratories Private Limited. Pinnacle describes a seven-stage child-development pathway connecting ability measurement, child-specific planning, integrated support, parent-guided practice and progress review toward participation and growing independence.

The documented combination brings together non-diagnostic Class B developmental-support software, a BIS scope schedule naming connected software modules, and a centre network with individually traceable source records. These documents explain the approach and its scope; each child’s plan and outcomes remain individual.

Scale claims · Dates and definitions

2.7 billion+ reported structured records · dated counts with defined units

What this means for your family

Consistent records can support continuity across a child’s journey. Ask to see your child’s own goals and progress reviews alongside network-level numbers.

Measurement date
17 July 2026, as described in the September handout
Therapy services reported
31,052,382
Operational centres reported
49 under the stated four-condition test
People metric reported
792,614 unique beneficiary / family registrations
Structured platform records reported
2,700,000,000+ observed database row/event counts
Counting unit
Discrete structured record: session entry, assessment observation, technique rating, sensor event or equivalent mapped field
Technique repository update
130,000 entries; management-supplied 18 September 2026. Earlier 7 September handout: 90,000+ techniques.
International reach reported
Families from 70+ countries of origin, including remote delivery; company-reported
Network reported
70+ centres including network stages distinct from the report’s operational-centre test

What this supports

The September handout reports 2.7 billion+ structured platform records and connects dated operational counts to specified procedures and Board-adopted criteria. It separately describes a 70+ network figure. The 2.5 billion floor assertion and 2.7 billion observed row-count finding have different reporting roles.

Scope & limits

Therapy services include assessments, screenings and parent training under the report’s criteria; they are not all one-to-one therapy sessions. Beneficiary/family registrations are not a count of unique children. Network and operational centres use different definitions. Platform records are not unique children, independent clinical-trial observations or verified, deduplicated AI-training examples. Volume alone does not establish model performance, clinical effectiveness or a worldwide size ranking. The 130,000 technique update has no inspected inventory extract; neither practitioner report establishes that updated count or the 70+ countries claim.

The July dossier used a 2.5 billion+ floor and retired earlier 2.7 billion wording. The September handout subsequently publishes 2.7 billion+ observed row counts. Limited assurance over the 2.5 billion floor is distinct from factual findings without an assurance opinion on the 2.7 billion row count. The 70+ network and 49 operational-centre figures also use different definitions.

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR YOUR FAMILY

Three questions.
A clearer starting point.

Section link

Credentials are most useful when they help you ask informed questions about the support your child will receive.

Is this the right document?

Match the name of the product or centre, its address and the activity covered. Ask for the latest copy for the place you will visit.

Check centre records ↗

What can it tell me?

A licence describes permitted activity. A quality certificate describes a system. A study explores a specific question in a defined group of children.

Understand evidence types ↗

How will we know it is helping?

Ask how your child’s starting abilities, goals and progress will be measured, when the plan will be reviewed and how practice carries into home and school.

See the seven-stage pathway ↗

THE MEANING BEHIND THE SCALE

2.7 billion+

Structured developmental records.
One child’s journey at a time.

Section link

Company-reported in the 7 September 2026 handout.
Counting basis: database rows/events · cutoff 17 July 2026.

See the dated metric and counting basis

A developmental journey you can follow.

Session entries, assessment observations, technique ratings and other platform events can preserve a record over time. The practical question is how that history helps the care team review your child’s plan.

Volume describes the size of the record system. Useful decisions also depend on data quality, consistent measurement, appropriate use and professional judgement.

This is not a count of unique children, independent clinical-trial observations or verified AI-training examples. A large count alone does not prove clinical effectiveness.
Why do some Pinnacle sources say 2.5 billion+ and others 2.7 billion+?

The July dossier used a 2.5 billion+ floor and retired earlier 2.7 billion wording. The September handout subsequently reports 2.7 billion+ observed row counts. The source review distinguishes the 2.5 billion floor assertion in limited assurance from the 2.7 billion factual row-count finding under agreed procedures. Those procedures do not provide an assurance opinion.

These are dated measures with different reporting roles. Neither should be described as an audited count of AI-training examples. Restricted practitioner reports are not republished here.

Read Pinnacle’s source record

A DEFINED PURPOSE. TRACEABLE RESPONSIBILITIES.

Understand what each
credential adds.

Section link

An issued licence defines the software’s intended use. Quality records describe how the system is managed. The BIS schedule connects those processes to a broader set of developmental-support modules.

APPLICATION HISTORY

MD-3

The application for a manufacturing licence. It is part of the regulatory record, rather than a second approval.

Read Pinnacle’s source record
ISSUED MANUFACTURING LICENCE

MD-5 · Class B

Telangana DCA licence MFG/MD/2026/000248 lists PinnacleAI GPT-OS v1.0.0 for non-diagnostic developmental support, ages 0–12.

Read Pinnacle’s source record
SYSTEMS & MODULES

BIS scope schedule

The schedule names software development, deployment and maintenance, plus ability mapping, parent-guided practice, progress correction and readiness modules.

Read Pinnacle’s source record

Four functions named in the MD-5 intended use

  • Developmental ability measurement
  • Readiness tracking
  • Progress forecasting
  • Adaptive therapy-plan support

Parents, therapists, educators and caregivers are the intended users. The licensed software supports developmental work; it does not diagnose, approve every therapy centre or guarantee a child’s outcome.

Class B is a risk classification under India’s rules. US FDA Class II is a different jurisdiction’s classification; neither is a universal ranking of quality or clinical superiority. CDSCO · Medical Devices Rules

WHY THE EVIDENCE MATTERS

One child.
A connected path forward.

Section link

Measurement should lead to a useful plan, everyday practice and decisions informed by progress. This is the seven-stage care pathway Pinnacle describes.

  1. 01 Understand

    Identify capabilities with AbilityScore® measurement.

  2. 02 Plan

    Forecast readiness and shape a child-specific plan.

  3. 03 Support

    Coordinate therapies and intervention.

  4. 04 Practise

    Bring parent-guided practice into everyday life.

  5. 05 Track

    Review progress and correct the plan.

  6. 06 Reassess

    Repeat assessment and support toward readiness.

  7. 07 Participate

    Work toward independence, school readiness and life with others.

PinnacleAI GPT-OS is described as non-diagnostic developmental-support software. Readiness and outcomes vary by child; school entry, graduation and independence are not guaranteed. Read the company pathway source · BIS module scope.

GLOBAL PRINCIPLES. PINNACLE’S DOCUMENTED APPROACH.

Why these capabilities
matter to families.

Section link

Independent guidance explains the importance of monitoring, caregiver participation, coordinated support and inclusion. These organisations do not endorse or evaluate Pinnacle through the references below.

Development happens across a child’s whole day.

The Nurturing Care Framework brings together health, learning, responsive caregiving and supportive environments.

WHO, UNICEF and World Bank · Nurturing Care
Pinnacle connection

Pinnacle’s seven-stage pathway connects a developmental plan with therapy, home practice and participation goals.

Read Pinnacle’s source record

Ask the care team: How will the plan connect with our child’s day at home and school?

A plan that comes home with you.

“skills that they can use at home to improve their child’s engagement in activities and communication”

WHO describes practical caregiver skills for families of children with developmental delays or disabilities.

WHO · Caregiver skills training
Pinnacle connection

The BIS schedule names Everyday Therapy through TherapeuticAI and parent/family tracking through Fusion.

Read Pinnacle’s source record

Ask the care team: What can we practise between sessions, and who will guide us?

Clarity starts with noticing change.

“Although early intervention is important, intervention at any age can be helpful.”

CDC distinguishes ongoing developmental monitoring from formal screening and professional evaluation.

CDC · Developmental monitoring and screening
Pinnacle connection

Pinnacle’s licensed non-diagnostic software includes ability measurement and readiness tracking. This CDC reference does not validate AbilityScore as a screening test.

Read Pinnacle’s source record

Ask the care team: What is our starting point, and when will we review progress?

Shared goals. Clear responsibilities.

NICE recommends coordinated multidisciplinary support and developmentally appropriate parent, carer or teacher involvement for autistic children and young people.

NICE CG170 · Support and management
Pinnacle connection

Pinnacle describes integrated therapies and regular plan review. Families can ask how professionals share goals and who coordinates their child’s support.

Read Pinnacle’s source record

Ask the care team: Who brings the team’s observations together into one plan?

More ways to take part.

“UNESCO believes that every learner matters equally.”

Inclusive education addresses barriers in teaching and learning environments.

UNESCO · Inclusion in education
Pinnacle connection

Pinnacle’s pathway works toward communication, daily living and participation. Readiness goals do not determine a child’s right to education or inclusion.

Read Pinnacle’s source record

Ask the care team: Which supports will help our child participate with others?

Technology with defined responsibilities.

“Software risk management requires a balanced evaluation of both safety and security.”

IMDRF describes quality management across medical-software development, deployment and maintenance.

IMDRF · SaMD quality management
Pinnacle connection

Pinnacle’s MD-5, BIS, quality-system and information-security records document different parts of this accountability picture.

Read Pinnacle’s source record

Ask the care team: What is the software intended for, and how are safety and changes managed?

AN INTERNATIONAL PERSPECTIVE

See where Pinnacle fits.
Compare what matters.

Section link

Different organisations address diagnosis, assessment, digital treatment, integrated services or provider software. A useful comparison starts with the job each is designed to do.

Pinnacle’s documented combination

Non-diagnostic developmental-support software with an issued MD-5, a BIS schedule naming connected developmental modules, and a company-described seven-stage care pathway. For families, the important connection is between measurement, a plan, everyday practice and review.

Originals reviewed.
Conclusions made clear.

Maintaining the recordUpdate with the source

New licences, renewals, issuer checks and completed study results can change a conclusion. Each update retains the document reference and date.

Review conclusions & evidence scope

Application + MD-5 reviewed

Classification: follow the issued licence

Class B is documented in the issued MD-5. The earlier Class A application is retained as part of the regulatory history.

Evidence scope: The separate issued CAL copy is not in the reviewed set; its date and reference are attributed to company publications.

Read the source record
Originals reviewed

Licence and registration copies: read their stated scope

Original licence and registration copies are reviewed by named entity, activity, reference and printed dates.

Evidence scope: Current suspension, cancellation, renewal or amendment status requires a dated issuer check. Only exact live registry matches receive the registry badge.

Read the source record
Historical original reviewed

GST: preserve the historical record

The 2017 REG-06 is retained with its printed legal and trade names, alongside the company name-change history.

Evidence scope: The reviewed certificate does not establish the current amended legal name or taxpayer status.

Read the source record
Original protocol reviewed

External validation: identify the source as a protocol

The reviewed external-validation source is a published study protocol. It sets out planned methods; completed results are not claimed.

Evidence scope: A final study report, with its population, methods, results and limitations, would support a new evidence conclusion.

Read the source record
Source publications reviewed

Outcome claims: keep the calculation boundary visible

The headline improvement claim is recorded as company-reported. No verified network-wide percentage is concluded from this document set.

Evidence scope: The SAE 3000 scope excludes outcome-study figures. A defined denominator and reproducible calculation are required to evaluate the headline claim.

Read the source record
Source review recorded

Centre evidence: match each document to its premises

All 52 workbook centres are included. Across the workbook and inspected certificate copies, 53 distinct HFR identifiers are retained. Eight district summaries and four individually inspected district originals remain separate.

Evidence scope: Workbook RS flags do not establish operational or HFR status. Nellore’s district certificate period ended on 30 October 2024. The additional Tirupati certificate is retained without assuming replacement or cancellation.

Read the source record
Original reports reviewed

Practitioner reports: preserve the stated scope

Report particulars and scope are recorded. Restricted full reports are not republished here.

Evidence scope: The reports’ circulation restrictions remain attached. A UDIN match authenticates particulars and does not enlarge a report’s assurance scope.

HOW TO READ THIS PAGE

Evidence with
its meaning intact.

Section link

A record is useful when you can see both what it supports and the limits of that support.

01 / PROVENANCE

Start with the source

Original documents take priority over cover letters, brochures and website summaries. The review date describes our inspection, not a fresh confirmation from the issuer.

02 / SCOPE

Match the exact entity

Read the named company, product, address and permitted activity. A product licence does not establish the registration of every therapy centre.

03 / MEANING

Keep each claim precise

Business identity, quality systems, clinical evidence and government appreciation serve different purposes. Ask what each one means for your child’s plan; individual outcomes vary.

Evidence status, explained

Original reviewed
A supplied original or primary publication record was inspected. Current status and independent validation are separate checks.
Registry record matched
The exact entity and identifier were checked against an official registry on the review date.
Company-published
Published by Pinnacle or its authors. This label does not imply independent validation.
Evidence scope
An adjacent scope label distinguishes a historical certificate, an application, a study protocol or a company-reported outcome. Original review does not expand what the document establishes.
Review boundaries & publication notes +

The source register was prepared on 15 September 2026, with selected originals and review conclusions rechecked on 18 September 2026. The page does not represent a regulator’s certification service. The named verification contact can help with source questions and corrections. The cited organisations have not endorsed this page. Live registry matches are counted only when an exact record has been checked against an official registry source.

Public document copies preserve issuer, entity, reference, scope and dates while removing personal identifiers and signatures where appropriate. A document’s stated validity is recorded separately from a live check for suspension, cancellation or changes. View file-integrity records.

Research protocols describe planned methods. Company summaries and operational totals are not substitutes for completed study results with methods, populations, outcomes and limitations.

THE WORDS BEHIND THE DOCUMENTS

Clear terms.
Better questions.

Section link

A practical reading guide to the credentials and report types used on this page. Each definition links to its Pinnacle source record.

SaMDSoftware as a Medical Device

Software intended for a medical purpose without being part of a hardware medical device. PinnacleAI GPT-OS is listed as Class B, non-diagnostic developmental-support software in the supplied MD-5.

Read the source record
MD-3Application for a manufacturing licence

The application submitted for a licence to manufacture Class A or Class B medical devices. An application is a step in the regulatory record; it is not the issued licence.

Read the source record
MD-5Issued manufacturing licence

The issued licence records the named manufacturer, premises, device and intended use. Pinnacle’s supplied MD-5 names PinnacleAI GPT-OS v1.0.0 for non-diagnostic developmental support, ages 0–12.

COMMON VERIFICATION QUESTIONS

Clear answers. Connected to the source.

Section link
What is PinnacleAI GPT-OS licensed for?

The supplied MD-5 lists PinnacleAI GPT-OS v1.0.0 as a Class B, non-diagnostic developmental-support device. Its scope is tied to the named device, version, intended use and premises; it does not establish diagnostic authority or guarantee clinical outcomes.

Read the evidence record
Are an MD-3 application and an MD-5 licence the same?

No. MD-3 is an application for a manufacturing licence. MD-5 is the issued manufacturing licence. The original application is reviewed; Class B is recorded on the issued MD-5. The separate issued classification decision copy was not available for inspection.

Read the evidence record
What do the BIS and ISO records establish?

They describe specified management systems and the activities and locations within their scope. They do not establish the effectiveness of every intervention or promise a particular outcome for a child.

Read the evidence record
Does a research protocol prove external validation?

No. A protocol describes planned methods. The AbilityScore external-validation record here is a protocol; completed results and their limitations are needed before treating that study as completed validation.

Read the evidence record
Does one credential cover every Pinnacle centre?

No. Match the named institution and premises on each document. This collection contains all 52 workbook centres and 53 distinct HFR identifiers across the workbook and certificate copies. Eight district summaries are separate; these are not counts of verified active centres.

Read the evidence record

What does Pinnacle’s 2.7 billion+ data-point figure mean?

The September 2026 company handout reports 2.7 billion+ structured platform records, based on database rows/events with a 17 July 2026 cutoff. Examples include session entries, assessment observations and technique ratings. The number is not a count of unique children, independent trial observations or verified AI-training examples.

Read the evidence record
Does this establish the world’s largest child-development dataset?

No comparable worldwide ranking is established. For example, CentralReach reports over 5 billion clinical and financial data points, using a different counting basis. A valid comparison would need common definitions, dates, populations, data quality and permitted uses.

Read the evidence record
Does the MD-5 licence approve the entire child-development lifecycle?

The MD-5 names PinnacleAI GPT-OS v1.0.0 and defined non-diagnostic functions for ages 0–12. The broader BIS schedule lists software processes and developmental-support modules across the journey. These instruments establish different scopes; neither guarantees outcomes or certifies global exclusivity.

Read the evidence record
Do WHO, UNICEF, CDC, NICE or UNESCO endorse Pinnacle?

No endorsement is established by the references on this page. Their guidance explains why monitoring, coordinated support, caregiver participation and inclusion matter. Pinnacle’s own documents must separately establish what Pinnacle provides.
